## Required

Eight fields: four IDs; capture and release conditions; gear interaction; leader material.

## Available

Health and hook-position data are partly filled. Photo references exist on 1,267 catches across the full selection.

Only 20 catches link an individual branchline, and individual leader material is empty.

Global set compositions record monofilament leader material, but using that for an individual needs agreement.

## To decide

Identify eligible animals, including seabirds and unmeasured animals, and retain their actual health observations.

Validate interaction and material correspondence; do not infer a missing release condition or invent a diameter.

An empty sheet is structurally possible; the reporting rule remains open.

[Detailed review](ll-17-e-set-catch-specimens-ssi.html) · [Short review index](ll-sheet-summaries.html).

## Export safeguard: ambiguous leader composition

Using the set composition for an individual's leader material remains conditional on IRD confirmation.

If that fallback is used, more than one composition entry must trigger an explicit anomaly for review.

Do not select a material automatically or silently omit the animal. Retain its trip, set and catch identifiers.

Whether this blocks the row or the whole trip export remains to be decided. The safeguard is not yet implemented.
